meta.title: Partners
meta.description: Partner with DSS — access Berkeley's top data science talent for consulting, research, and recruiting.

hero.heading: Work with us
hero.subtext: We partner with companies on semester-long data science project engagements that allow our members to work through real industry problems from start to finish.

inquiryForm.heading: Get in touch
inquiryForm.subtext: Tell us a little about your company and what you'd like to work on.
inquiryForm.successBody: We'll be in touch within 48 hours.

waysToPartner.heading: More than one way to work together.
waysToPartner.subtext: Consulting projects are our primary form of engaging with a company, but there are a handful of other ways to partner with DSS, from recruiting to speaker events and hackathons.

process.heading: More Details About Our Process
process.subtext: Projects run on a semester cadence with a dedicated team and a defined scope to work on.

cards.title: Team structure
paragraphs: Each engagement gets a hand-picked team of students consisting of 2 project managers, 3-4 consultants, and a senior advisor. Students are picked for a project based on relevant experience in the project scope or the client’s industry. Weekly check-ins are also in place to keep clients in the loop without directly managing the project.

cards.title: Why student teams
paragraphs: Our members intern across industry throughout their time at Berkeley and go on to full-time roles at leading technology, finance, and consulting firms.
Partnering is the best way to not only target a focused project scope but also build an early talent pipeline.

projectTimeline.heading: Project Timeline
projectTimeline.subtext: Click on a stage to view each portion of a project timeline.
projectTimeline.legendText: — both semesters follow the same five stages.

stages.title: Contracts & Scoping
stages.detail: We finalize the SOW + additional documents and lock the project scope together. Everything regarding projects, from legal forms to the problem statement are defined here before project work starts.

stages.title: Work Begins
stages.detail: We start off with an onboarding call between the client’s POCs and our full DSS team to align on project deliverables/goals. Project work begins starting from here.

stages.title: Midpoint Deliverables
stages.detail: Around the halfway mark, the team shares project progress up to this point and a first preview of the deliverable. This is the point for the client to also reset expectations or change certain project aspects before the final deliverable.

stages.title: Final Deliverables
stages.detail: The team presents the final work and product through a live demo and slideshow presentation. All materials will be packaged to be used by the client.

stages.title: Materials Transfer
stages.detail: We hand off all code, data, and documentation, and close out access to any shared resources. We also do a final wrap-up call to make sure everything was received.
